# Wutcharin Thatan

> Associate Director, FinTech Data & Automation at Agoda (Bangkok). Leads a 12-person Analytics Engineering team. Has automated 15,000+ hours a year and ships AI agents (RAG, Auto-SQL) in production. Earlier: Head of Commercial at Really Cool Airlines, Head of Strategic Foresight at Thairath Group, Planning Director at Nok Air.
